title: Ye Bata Karbobala
body:
Ye bata karbobala..(4)
Kis tarha aale mohammad pe hue zulm o jafa
Ye bata karbobala..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Paani hote hue kyu ibne ali pyaasa raha
<<MINI>>
Ye bata karbobala..(2)
Kis tarha aale mohammad pe hue zulm o jafa
Ye bata karbobala..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Shabe ashoor ko dulha jo bana tha qasim
haaye dulha qasim..(2)
kis tarha dasht mein wo ghodo se pamaal hua
<<MINI>>
Ye bata karbobala..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jab alamdaar ke bazu hue maqtal mein juda
zeen par ruk na saka..(2)
zeen se khaak pe kis tarha alamdaar gira
<<MINI>>
Ye bata karbobala..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ali akbar jise kehti thi ali ki beti
wo tha ham shakl e nabi..(2)
uske laashe pe hussain ibne ali kaise gaya
<<MINI>>
Ye bata karbobala..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Leke beemar ka paigham jo yasrab se chala
ashk barsata hua..(2)
haye kis waqt pe wo qaside sughra pohcha
<<MINI>>
Ye bata karbobala..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Apne baba ko jo baba bhi nahi bol saka
ghutniyo bhi na chala..(2)
teer kaise usi masoom ki gardan pe laga
<<MINI>>
Ye bata karbobala..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Teer se chalni badan zakhmo se khoo'n jaari tha
lab pe tha shukre khuda..(2)
sajda e aakhri shabbir ne kis tarha kiya
<<MINI>>
Ye bata karbobala..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Baap ke seene pe bachi jo sada soti thi
sham e ghurbat me wohi..(2)
kis tarha teero bhare seene pe soyi tanha
<<MINI>>
Ye bata karbobala..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Qafla gyara moharram ko rawane jo hua
berida tha kunba..(2)
sar jhukaye huw kis tarha se beemar chala
<<MINI>>
Ye bata karbobala..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Phir se deedar ko aankhein ye tarasti hai meri
dil mein hasrat hai yehi..(2)
hoga rehan ko kab izn ziyarat ka ataa
<<MINI>>
Ye bata karbobala..(2)
